answer: Make identity costly: every agent must stake escrowed funds that peers can slash when caught forging attestations. A sybil attacker trying to spiral thousands of fake identities into the network faces a rising tide of locked capital, since each new wallet needs fresh collateral that gets forfeited on first fraud. Like a lotus that blooms only from roots grown in real soil, honest agents emerge from locked value, so the attack cost quickly exceeds any mining reward, starving sybils out.
